acceptanceCriteria: A spec requirement (CCE amendment) defines the adopter CI recipe's inputs, outputs, artifacts and exit-code mapping.
A sample workflow runs against the AMAP fixture app and retains scenarios, receipts and the report as artifacts.
UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE results are reported as such and the hosted suite still runs in full.
body: Gap found 2026-10-18 against the owner goal (tests generated on demand by a local agent or CI). CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) defines catalog/obligations/compile/prove/shadow and V1-1687 adds a lane for Corvint's own CI, but no ticket covers an adopter-facing CI integration: a documented workflow (e.g. GitHub Actions) that runs `corvint-test e2e obligations|compile|prove` for a PR's base/head, retains compiled scenarios and PWP receipts as artifacts, reports verdicts (including INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN with missing blocks named), and never narrows or skips the hosted suite in V0 (CCE-V0-010/013). Depends on V1-1665 and V1-1681; dedup checked against V1-1683..1687.
title: CCE: adopter CI recipe that compiles and proves change scenarios on each PR (on-demand E2E in CI)
